operations.summary: Legacy release updates legacy_name only, never display_name
New release updates display_name only, never legacy_name
Copies legacy_name to display_name where display_name IS NULL via SELECT then conditional UPDATEs

conflicts.risk_explanation: Backfill SELECTs legacy_name then later UPDATEs display_name. A concurrent v1 UPDATE to legacy_name between SELECT and UPDATE is missed, so display_name is set to a stale value and stays diverged forever since nothing re-syncs.

Releases write different columns with no dual-write or trigger. v1 leaves display_name stale, v2 leaves legacy_name stale, so concurrent updates to the same row leave the two name columns diverged (split-brain).
Both write display_name. Backfill must not clobber a concurrent v2 value. Current code guards UPDATE with WHERE display_name IS NULL; without that guard backfill would cause lost update of v2.

tests.name: backfill_stale_copy_vs_legacy_write
tests.rationale: Backfill reads legacy_name in one txn then writes display_name in later txns. If v1 updates legacy_name after the SELECT, backfill copies the old value, leaving display_name stale. Distinguishable values orig vs v1_new expose the stale copy.

invariants.description: v1 write to legacy_name must not be lost
display_name should stay in sync with final legacy_name if correctly maintained

tests.name: v1_v2_split_brain_divergence
tests.rationale: v1 and v2 update different columns of the same synced row with distinct values. Correct dual-write would keep columns equal with last-writer-wins; current code leaves legacy=v1_new and display=v2_new diverged.

invariants.description: final legacy_name is one of the two writers values under any correct last-writer-wins sync
final display_name is one of the two writers values under any correct sync
both name columns should agree if dual-write is correct; current code leaves them split

tests.name: backfill_must_not_clobber_v2
tests.rationale: Both backfill (copying orig) and v2 (writing v2_new) write display_name on a NULL row. Guard WHERE display_name IS NULL should make v2 win in every interleaving; distinct values detect lost update if guard were missing.

invariants.description: v2 value must survive; guarded backfill must not overwrite it in any interleaving
legacy_name untouched by either backfill or v2

tests.name: backfill_batch_with_concurrent_row_writes
tests.rationale: Batch backfill over two NULL rows races with v2 on row 1 and v1 on row 2. Row 1 checks no-clobber guard per-row; row 2 checks stale-copy where v1 slips between batch SELECT and second UPDATE. All values distinct to attribute final state.

invariants.description: guarded backfill must not overwrite concurrent v2 on row 1 in any order
v1 write to row 2 legacy must not be lost
row 2 display should match final legacy if kept in sync; stale SELECT leaves orig
